grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
ref-defs-SourceGoal ::= "{" space ref-defs-SourceGoal-description-kv "," space ref-defs-SourceGoal-priority-kv "," space ref-defs-SourceGoal-source-quote-kv "," space ref-defs-SourceGoal-observable-kv space "}"
ref-defs-SourceGoal-description ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-SourceGoal-description-kv ::= "\"description\"" space ":" space ref-defs-SourceGoal-description
ref-defs-SourceGoal-observable ::= "\"" char* "\""
ref-defs-SourceGoal-observable-kv ::= "\"observable\"" space ":" space ref-defs-SourceGoal-observable
ref-defs-SourceGoal-priority ::= ("\"required\"" | "\"preferred\"" | "\"context\"")
ref-defs-SourceGoal-priority-kv ::= "\"priority\"" space ":" space ref-defs-SourceGoal-priority
ref-defs-SourceGoal-source-quote ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-SourceGoal-source-quote-kv ::= "\"source_quote\"" space ":" space ref-defs-SourceGoal-source-quote
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-goals-kv "," space response-format-schema-candidate-count-kv "," space response-format-schema-candidate-format-kv "," space response-format-schema-candidate-source-quote-kv "," space response-format-schema-interpretation-notes-kv space "}"
response-format-schema-candidate-count ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9] | "1" [0-1] [0-9] | "120")
response-format-schema-candidate-count-kv ::= "\"candidate_count\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-candidate-count
response-format-schema-candidate-format ::= ("\"unspecified\"" | "\"separate_candidates\"" | "\"single_composite\"")
response-format-schema-candidate-format-kv ::= "\"candidate_format\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-candidate-format
response-format-schema-candidate-source-quote ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-candidate-source-quote-kv ::= "\"candidate_source_quote\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-candidate-source-quote
response-format-schema-goals ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-goals-item ("," space response-format-schema-goals-item){0,59})? space "]"
response-format-schema-goals-item ::= ref-defs-SourceGoal
response-format-schema-goals-kv ::= "\"goals\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-goals
response-format-schema-interpretation-notes ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-interpretation-notes-item ("," space response-format-schema-interpretation-notes-item){0,29})? space "]"
response-format-schema-interpretation-notes-item ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-interpretation-notes-kv ::= "\"interpretation_notes\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-interpretation-notes
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: Defer only sampler string maxLength; retain all complete source schema bytes and SHA binding
transformation.unchanged: JSON types, exact keys, required members, enum, string minLength and every array minItems/maxItems
transformation.method: Deterministic GBNF for the exact source-reading or localization consumer; fixed integer bounds, polygon/rectangle alternatives, coordinate tuples and array bounds are retained.
transformation.length_scope: Only string maxLength is omitted from sampler GBNF to avoid the installed 6703d7894 repetition parser boundary. String minLength and all array minItems/maxItems remain enforced by this grammar. The complete original schema, text system/prompt and host Pydantic retain every string maximum; overlong responses must be rejected without truncation or repair.
transformation.input_scope: Original-source text reading, not artwork authoring or approval
